login_session_ended: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.
register_closed: This installation does not accept new accounts.
mowers_empty_owner: Add your first mower. A simulated mower is enough to try MowDeck.
mowers_empty_viewer: No mower has been shared with you yet.
mowers_live_limited: Live values only for the first 200 mowers.
install_hint: Install MowDeck as an app on this device.
install_ios_hint: iPhone and iPad: Share, then “Add to Home Screen”.
detail_areas_empty: No map received from the mower yet.
detail_not_found_body: This mower does not exist or has not been shared with you.
detail_access_ended: Your access to this mower has ended.
detail_no_telemetry: The mower has not reported any values yet.
area_rename_hint_mower: Name on the mower: {name}. The mower keeps its own name.
area_rename_hint_none: The mower has no name of its own for this area. Without a name it is called “{fallback}”.
area_rename_reset_done: Custom name removed, the area is called “{name}” again.
reason_start: Only while the mower is at rest.
reason_dock: The mower is already at the station.
dock_choice_hint: End the running job, or only drive home and keep it paused to resume later?
area_picker_hint: The order of selection is the mowing order.
mower_kind_change_warning: Changing the connection makes the gateway reconnect to the mower.
mower_delete_body: Removes the mower with its history, map and commands. This cannot be undone.
users_must_change: Change the password at first sign-in
tokens_secret_once: The token is shown only now. Copy it to a safe place.
password_must_change: Please set your own password before you continue.
problem_forbidden: You are not allowed to do this.
problem_rate_limited: Too many requests. Please try again in a minute.
problem_unavailable: The service is not reachable right now.
offline_body: No connection to the server. The app reloads as soon as the network is back.
map_select_hint: Tap areas on the map to choose them for Start.
map_route_truncated: Only the newest points are shown.
map_fallback: The interactive map could not be loaded; showing the plan.
conn_unknown_kind: This connection kind is not enabled here; its options stay unchanged.
conn_secret_keep_hint: Stored. Leave empty to keep it, or enter a new value.
conn_simulated_description: A simulated mower in the Device-Gateway with a demo garden. It needs no settings; simulator settings such as time_scale are kept.
conn_cloud_description: Connects through the Mammotion cloud (MQTT) with a linked Mammotion account: link the account once, then pick its mowers.
conn_ble_description: Connects over Bluetooth through an ESPHome Bluetooth proxy near the mower; no camera. With a cloud account it is better added as an additional link (mower settings, Bluetooth bridge). Manual driving works only over this link.
conn_cloud_account_help: The Mammotion account the mower is shared with.
conn_cloud_password_help: Plain password; accepted with a warning and never returned. A reference is better.
conn_credential_ref_help: env:NAME or file:/run/secrets/name, resolved in the environment of the Device-Gateway.
conn_cloud_device_name_help: The mower's name in the linked account, set from its device list.
conn_cloud_iot_id_help: The mower's IoT id in the Mammotion cloud, set from the device list.
conn_cloud_session_cache_help: File for the cloud tokens on a private, writable volume; avoids a password login on every reconnect.
conn_cloud_refresh_help: How often the mower is asked for a fresh status report; the Mammotion cloud sends reports only on request. 10 to 300 seconds.
conn_cloud_refresh_active_help: How often the mower is asked for a fresh status report while it mows, returns or is paused away from the dock. More requests, so more 4G traffic while it works; the idle interval is unchanged. 2 to 60 seconds.
conn_cloud_report_stream_help: Length of the continuous report window kept open while the mower works, renewed every half window. About one report per second, so the live position stays smooth. 0 turns it off. 10 to 300 seconds.
conn_map_sync_timeout_help: How long to wait for the map after connecting.
conn_confirm_timeout_help: How long a command waits for the mower to confirm it.
conn_ble_host_help: Host name or IP address of the ESPHome proxy.
conn_ble_noise_psk_help: The API encryption key from the ESPHome YAML (base64, 32 bytes); never returned.
conn_ble_key_ref_help: env:NAME or file:/run/secrets/name holding the encryption key.
conn_ble_address_help: The Bluetooth MAC address of the mower.
conn_ble_device_name_help: Advertised name; read from the advertisement when empty.
conn_ble_manual_blades_help: Off: the blades stay off while the mower is driven manually.
conn_ble_manual_drive_speed_help: Sent to the mower when a drive starts. Empty: the mower's own driving speed, at most 1.0.
conn_ble_scan_timeout_help: How long to look for the mower.
notif_empty_body: Choose what you want to hear about: mowing finished, stuck, battery low or offline.
notif_kind_mowing_finished_hint: A mowing job ends at the dock.
notif_kind_mower_stuck_hint: The mower reports an error or stops moving while mowing.
notif_kind_battery_low_hint: The battery falls below the threshold (once per discharge).
notif_kind_mower_offline_hint: The mower has not reported for a while.
notif_kind_mower_online_hint: The mower reports again after being offline.
notif_not_stored: Not saved yet: you do not get any alerts so far.
notif_quiet_hint: No push and no ntfy in this window; the inbox still gets the alerts.
notif_channel_webpush_hint: To every device where you enabled push.
notif_channel_apns_hint: To every iPhone with the MowDeck app (Apple Push, also when the app is closed).
native_apns_denied_hint: Notifications are off for MowDeck. Turn them on in the iPhone settings: Settings, MowDeck, Notifications.
native_apns_error_hint: The iPhone could not register with Apple Push. Check the network and try again.
native_apns_no_server: This server has no Apple Push key, so the app notifies only while it is open.
native_android_hint: Android gets no push from the server (that would need Google Firebase). While the app is open it notifies by itself; in the background the ntfy app delivers: set up a topic below and subscribe to it in ntfy.
notif_push_enable_hint: The browser asks for permission to show notifications.
notif_push_enabled: Push is on for this device.
notif_push_insecure: Web Push needs HTTPS. Over HTTP it works on localhost only; set up TLS on the gateway (for example Tailscale HTTPS).
notif_push_ios: On iPhone and iPad, Web Push reaches only the installed app: Share, then “Add to Home Screen”, and open the app from there.
notif_push_unsupported: This browser does not support Web Push. Use ntfy or another browser.
notif_push_denied: Notifications are blocked for this site. Allow them in the browser settings.
notif_push_no_key: Web Push is not set up on this server.
notif_push_failed: The browser returned no push subscription.
notif_ntfy_hint: Alerts in the ntfy app: subscribe to the same topic on the same server there.
notif_ntfy_topic_hint: Up to 64 letters, digits, - or _; pick one that is hard to guess.
notif_ntfy_token_hint: Only for protected topics (tk_…); never shown again.
notif_test_hint: Sends a test alert over every configured channel, at most once a minute.
notif_test_inbox_only: Inbox only: no channel set up.
notif_kind_mower_lifted_hint: The lift sensor triggered. Alarms also during quiet hours.
notif_kind_mower_left_dock_unexpectedly_: The mower leaves the dock without a command. Alarms also during quiet hours.
notif_kind_geofence_exit_hint: The position is outside the mowing areas and paths. Alarms also during quiet hours.
notif_kind_blade_maintenance_hint: Blade hours since the last change exceed the threshold.
sched_empty_body: A schedule starts the mower on set days at the chosen time and holds it back when it rains.
sched_empty_viewer: There are no schedules for your mowers.
sched_permission_skips: {count} runs in a row skipped for missing permission
sched_skip_done: The next run will be skipped.
sched_enabled_hint: Off: the schedule is kept but does not start.
sched_run_body: “{name}” starts at once for {target}. The next planned run stays as it is.
sched_run_respect_rain_hint: When it rains or the grass is wet the start is skipped as “rain”.
sched_read_only: You can view this schedule but not change it.
sched_no_targets: There is no mower or group you may create schedules for.
sched_anchor_hint: The interval counts from this day.
sched_duration_hint: {duration}: no start after the window closed.
sched_return_at_end: Return to the dock at window end
sched_return_at_end_hint: A mower still mowing returns when the window ends.
sched_areas_hint: Tap the areas on the map in mowing order. Nothing chosen: every area.
sched_areas_group: A group schedule mows every area of each mower in the group.
sched_areas_no_map: There is no map for this mower yet: the schedule mows every area.
sched_rotation_hint: Each run takes the next angle of the list, so no tracks form in the lawn.
sched_rain_enabled_hint: Before every start the forecast at the site is checked.
sched_rain_unknown_hint: When the weather service does not answer.
sched_rain_running: Stop a running job when it rains
sched_rain_running_hint: The mower returns to the dock as soon as it starts to rain.
sched_err_group_areas: Group schedules always mow every area
sched_preview_saved_state: The preview shows the saved state.
sched_preview_after_save: The next runs show in the preview after saving.
sched_preview_now: The rain decision at the mower now; the next runs after saving.
sched_strip_summary: Forecast: at most {percent} % chance of rain, {mm} mm per hour
sched_runs_empty_body: Every start and every skipped run shows up here.
detail_no_schedule: No active schedule for this mower.
site_hint: Schedules run in the site's time zone; the rain pause asks the weather at its coordinates.
site_default_hint: The default site keeps its name.
site_rain_fallback: Without coordinates the rain pause uses the mower's map origin or last position.
rtk_map_show_hint: Colours the grid by the RTK reception of the driven points.
drive_open_hint: Steer with the stick, dead-man stop after one second
drive_stop_hint: Halts the mower at once and ends the session.
drive_pad_hint: Hold and drag, or use the arrow keys on a desktop. Let go to halt.
drive_blades_switch_hint: Arm first, then switch on. Every stop and every error disarms the blades.
drive_blades_unsupported: This mower drives manually with the blades off only.
drive_blades_session: The blades will be allowed for the next session.
drive_safety: The mower halts at most {ttl} ms after drive commands stop arriving. Obstacle and lift sensors stay active. Leaving the page, switching tabs or losing the connection ends the session.
drive_unsupported: This mower cannot be driven manually over its current connection.
drive_no_permission: You may not drive this mower manually.
drive_busy_job: Pause or end the mowing job before driving manually.
drive_socket_down: No live connection. Driving needs it.
drive_map_empty: No map yet. The position shows once the mower reports it.
drive_ended_mower_busy: Session ended: the mower is busy
drive_ended_replaced: Session ended: a new session was started
drive_error_not_allowed: You may not drive this mower manually.
drive_error_unsupported: The mower cannot be driven manually right now (connection or capabilities unknown).
drive_error_busy: This mower is already being driven manually.
drive_error_unavailable: The drive service does not answer. Please try again.
drive_error_not_active: The drive session is no longer active.
health_blade_source_device: The mower's own counter and interval (as in the Mammotion app)
health_battery_empty: No battery values in the last 24 hours.
health_battery_label: Battery over the last 24 hours from {min} to {max} percent
health_blade_reset_hint: Resets the hours since the change and re-arms the reminder.
health_blade_reset_device_hint: The mower counts blade hours itself. Reset that counter in the Mammotion app; this only resets MowDeck's counter.
health_blade_note_hint: For example: spare set, all three replaced
health_no_data: No health data yet. It builds up once the mower sends telemetry.
notif_ack_hint: Acknowledging silences this alarm for an hour.
detail_alarm_position_body: The alarm reported the mower at {lat}, {lon}.
bulk_confirm_body: {scope}: {count} mower(s). Fleet checks every mower on its own; the result per mower shows here afterwards.
sites_delete_conflict: Only empty sites can be deleted: move their mowers and groups first. The default site stays.
sites_move_hint: The mower takes the new site's time zone and coordinates; its groups stay.
sites_move_none: All visible mowers are here already.
sites_viewer_hint: Users with the right to manage mowers can add and change sites.
groups_site_hint: Without a site the group spans sites.
groups_no_members: No mowers in this group yet.
groups_delete_conflict: Only empty groups can be deleted: take the mowers out first.
groups_empty_body: Groups bundle mowers, across sites too: for bulk commands, schedules and rights.
placement_hint: Where the mower belongs: rights, schedules and bulk commands of a site or group apply to it.
placement_forbidden: You lack the right to manage mowers at this target.
users_assign_hint: A role on a site, group or mower applies only there: staff see and control exactly those mowers.
reports_err_future: The period lies in the future
reports_export_hint: CSV in UTF-8 with ISO 8601 dates; German with semicolons and decimal commas, English with commas and decimal points.
reports_copy_failed: Copying is not possible; please use the CSV file.
reports_truncated: The period holds more data than one report shows; please choose a shorter one.
plan_usage_hint: In use counts what you can see in this account.
plan_billing_disabled: This installation has no subscription limits: every account uses every feature without a cap.
plan_restricted_body: Only viewing and the emergency stop remain. New mowers, sites, groups or schedules and other commands are blocked; no mower is stopped.
plan_unavailable: The plan cannot be loaded right now.
problem_feature_not_in_plan_detail: The plan of this account does not include this feature.
problem_plan_inactive_detail: In the grace period and after expiry only viewing and the emergency stop remain.
problem_plan_unavailable: The plan cannot be checked right now
op_forbidden_body: The operator console is for the administrators of this installation.
op_billing_off_body: Every account uses the plan “Unlimited”, whatever plan is assigned. Assignments apply once billing is switched on.
op_plans_billing_off: While billing is off, every account gets “unlimited”. Plan changes take effect only once billing is switched on.
op_search_hint: Name, owner or id, across all accounts
op_assign_until_hint: Empty: the plan's trial days or the installation's grace days
op_assign_until_invalid: The date must be in the future.
op_assign_restricted: In grace and after expiry the account keeps only viewing and the emergency stop.
op_no_mower_data: The console shows no mower data.
op_plan_default_hint: For new accounts unless the installation names another
op_plan_active_hint: Off: no longer offered, accounts keep it
op_plans_inactive_hint: Plans no longer offered open by their key in the editor.
op_plan_key_hint: Lower case, digits, - and _; cannot change
op_plan_key_invalid: Starts with a letter, then lower case, digits, - or _ (at most 64).
op_plan_trial_hint: 0 to 365; new accounts on this plan start a trial
op_plan_limits_hint: Empty means unlimited. Limits apply only with billing switched on.
op_plan_limit_invalid: A whole number from 0, or empty.
op_plan_from_file: This plan is in the plan file: when its entry there changes, the next start replaces this version.
op_fact_default_plan_note: Marked as default; the installation may name another
op_services_hint: Does every service answer through the gateway? Status and response time from this browser, not a readiness check.
op_matches_more: The first {shown} of {total} matches; search more precisely.
billing_trial_days: {days} days free trial for a first subscription
billing_portal_hint: Change the plan, the payment method or cancel at the payment provider.
billing_unavailable: The subscription cannot be loaded right now.
billing_invoices_unavailable: The invoices cannot be loaded right now.
billing_exists: This account already has a subscription: change it under Manage subscription.
billing_success: Thank you: the subscription is being activated.
legal_placeholder: Placeholder: to be completed by the operator
legal_unavailable: The page cannot be loaded right now.
source_about_text: MowDeck is free software under the GNU Affero General Public License, version 3. Everyone who uses this installation over a network may get the source code of exactly the version it runs.
camera_data_note: The video runs through Mammotion's and Agora's servers. On 4G every minute counts against the video allowance; close the camera when you do not need it.
camera_error_unsupported: This mower has no camera over its connection.
camera_error_not_in_plan: The live camera is not part of your plan.
camera_error_unavailable: The camera cannot be reached right now. Is the mower online?
camera_error_not_found: This mower no longer exists, or you cannot see it.
camera_error_insecure: Live video needs a secure connection: open MowDeck over HTTPS.
camera_error_disabled: Live video through the vendor cloud is switched off on this installation (MOWDECK_WEB_CAMERA_ENABLED).
camera_error_browser: This browser cannot play the live video.
camera_collapsed: Collapsed: no video session, no data used.
camera_diag_network: Packet loss now {loss} % (total {total} %) · delay {delay} ms ({source}) · RTT {rtt} ms
camera_diag_events: Since join: {states} state changes · {published} published · {unpublished} unpublished · {rejoins} rejoins
camera_opt_profile_hint: rtc joins like a call and is the most compatible; live joins as audience with a latency level. Changing it joins again.
camera_opt_latency_hint: Low is smoother, ultra low is faster but more fragile.
camera_opt_fallback_hint: On a poor network Agora drops to the low-quality stream and, if that is not enough, to audio only.
camera_opt_saver_hint: Always the low-quality stream. Works only if the mower sends two streams.
camera_opt_rejoin_hint: After a lost connection, join again with a fresh session.
camera_opt_transport_hint: Automatic uses MowDeck's camera relay and the direct vendor path only when there is no relay. Force one path for testing; the setting applies to this browser only.
vision_provider_none_hint: Set up a vision model under AI provider, or ask the operator for the installation's model.
vision_blades_off: Blades stay off during every AI assist maneuver.
vision_intro_recover: AI assist looks at a picture of the mower's surroundings and its map position and proposes a short, slow maneuver to free it. Nothing moves until you approve.
vision_intro_find_dock: AI assist looks at a picture of the surroundings and proposes a short, slow maneuver towards the dock, then sends the mower home. Nothing moves until you approve.
vision_image_camera: A snapshot of the camera picture is sent with the request.
vision_image_mower: The mower is asked for a photo; without one the model sees only the map context.
vision_start_find_dock: Analyse and propose a way to the dock
vision_analysing: The model is analysing the situation...
vision_snapshot_alt: The analysed snapshot of the mower's surroundings
vision_trigger_error_hint: The mower reported this error and automatic AI analysis is on. Nothing moves until you approve.
vision_executing_hint: The mower drives the steps slowly with the blades off. Use the emergency stop at any time.
vision_retry: Try again with a new picture
vision_outcome_docking: The maneuver is done; the mower is on its way to the dock.
vision_dock_hint: The mower drives home by itself on its mapped areas and paths, blades off. Nothing moves until you approve.
vision_fallback_hint: The AI recommended no maneuver. Returning to the dock still applies: the mower is in a mapped area linked to the dock and no lift or tilt stop is active.
vision_approve_dock: Approve and send to the dock
vision_outcome_dock_sent: The dock command was sent; the mower is on its way home.
vision_outcome_not_recovered: The mower is still stuck after the maneuver.
vision_outcome_expired: The proposal expired without a decision. Nothing was driven.
vision_outcome_rejected: The proposal was rejected. Nothing was driven.
vision_problem_quota: The daily limit of AI analyses is reached
vision_problem_secrets: API keys cannot be stored on this installation
vision_problem_provider_failed: The AI provider did not answer
ai_provider_intro: AI assist sends a picture of the mower's surroundings to a vision model of your choice and proposes a maneuver you approve. Choose the model here.
ai_provider_unavailable: AI assist is not available on this installation.
ai_provider_no_secrets: This installation has no key for storing secrets (MOWDECK_VISION_SECRETS_KEY). Use a local model without a key, or the installation's model.
ai_provider_base_hint: Address of the server that answers the model (for local and compatible servers).
ai_provider_key_keep: Leave empty to keep the stored key. The key is never shown again.
ai_provider_key_hint: Stored encrypted; it is never shown again.
ai_provider_key_missing: No key yet: the model only answers if the operator provides one.
ai_provider_enabled_hint: Off: AI assist uses the installation's model, if there is one.
ai_provider_cost_note: Every analysis is one paid request to the provider (a few cents at most, depending on the model; stereo frames send two images and cost about twice as much). A test costs about the same as a single image.
ai_provider_cloud_note: With a cloud model the camera picture and the map context leave this installation and go to the provider.
ai_provider_local_note: A local model keeps pictures on your own hardware.
ai_provider_error_model: Enter a model, e.g. the family's example.
ai_provider_error_prefix: The model of this family starts with {prefix}
ai_provider_error_base: This family needs a base URL.
ai_provider_error_base_url: Enter an http or https address.
ai_auto_hint: When a mower gets stuck, is blocked by an obstacle, leaves its work area or its wheels slip, MowDeck takes a camera picture, asks your model and sends you the proposal as a notification. Nothing moves until you approve. Lifting, low battery and blade errors never start an analysis.
ai_auto_limits: At most one analysis per mower every {minutes} min and {daily} per mower and day; each one is a paid request like a manual one.
ai_auto_needs_provider: Needs an AI provider: set up your model above or ask the operator for the installation's model.
ai_auto_unavailable: Automatic analyses are switched off on this installation.
ai_auto_notify_hint: The notification “AI proposal after an error” must be switched on for you to hear about it.
op_fact_vision_off: No installation model; users bring their own.
op_fact_vision_note: Vision service, model only, never a key.
notif_kind_vision_proposal_hint: AI assist proposes a maneuver that waits for your approval.
notif_kind_vision_auto_proposal_hint: Automatic AI analysis (switched on under AI provider) proposes a maneuver after an error; it waits for your approval.
notif_kind_firmware_update_available_hin: The manufacturer offers a new firmware for the mower; it can be installed in the mower settings.
notif_kind_firmware_update_finished_hint: The mower is back, running the new firmware.
notif_kind_firmware_update_failed_hint: The update stopped; the mower settings show the reason.
light_unsupported: This mower has no switchable camera light.
light_no_permission: You may not control this mower.
vision_light_used: Taken with the camera light on
vision_light_used_hint: The picture was too dark; the mower's camera light was switched on for it and off again afterwards.
linked_intro: Mammotion accounts MowDeck connects cloud mowers through. The password is stored encrypted and never shown.
linked_password_hint: Stored encrypted and never shown again.
linked_connect_hint: Use a second account the mowers are shared with: logging in with the main account logs the phone app out.
linked_connecting_hint: This can take up to a minute. Please keep the page open.
linked_login_failed: Mammotion refused the e-mail or password.
linked_unavailable: Signing in to Mammotion is not possible right now.
linked_no_permission: Linked accounts are managed by people who may manage mowers.
linked_new_password_hint: Only needed when the password was changed at Mammotion. Leave empty to keep the stored one.
linked_delete_body: MowDeck forgets the account and its password. Mowers that connect through it must be removed first.
linked_drafts_empty: Choose at least one mower above.
linked_failure_registered: This mower is registered in MowDeck already.
linked_managed_hint: Set by Fleet from the device list.
linked_managed_empty: set when the mower is added
linked_legacy_hint: This mower still uses an old cloud login. Link the Mammotion account under "Linked accounts" and add the mower again from there.
linked_kind_change_hint: Mowers of this kind are added from a linked account under "Add mower".
camera_both_note: Both front cameras: two video streams, about twice the data.
camera_same_picture: Both views show the same picture. The mower may be sending one camera twice.
vision_stereo_hint: Left and right front camera of the same moment; the model may estimate distances from the parallax.
vision_image_stereo: Both front camera frames of the same moment are sent (stereo, two images: about twice the image cost).
ai_provider_stereo_hint: With both front cameras live, AI assist sends both frames of the same moment so the model can judge distances. Two images cost about twice as much as one.
heat_period_fallback: No job among the recent commands: the last 24 h.
heat_empty: No data in this period yet.
heat_no_map: No map yet: the mower has not sent one.
heat_gaps_none: No missed spots in this period.
heat_gap_remow_unavailable: Spot mowing needs manual driving over the drive link and the right to drive this mower.
heat_gap_mow_area_hint: Opens the start with this area chosen.
start_remember_hint: Pre-fills the next start of this mower, in every app.
start_setpoints: Blade height and speed are set in the controls.
start_no_patterns: The mower reports no patterns of its own: it mows with its own settings.
path_toggle_hint: Show the route the mower planned on the map
path_status_waiting: The path follows once the mower sends it
start_preview_loading: The mower is planning the route …
start_preview_outdated: Selection changed: compute the path again
start_preview_timeout: The mower did not send the route in time.
start_preview_unsupported: This mower cannot compute its route in advance.
start_preview_hint: The mower plans the route without driving off. This takes a few seconds, over mobile data up to a minute.
start_setpoints_sent: Changed values go to the mower before the start; it keeps them afterwards.
start_rain_soon: Rain expected from {time} (probability {percent}), during the estimated job.
start_rain_wet: The lawn is probably still wet until about {time}.
reason_updating: The mower takes no commands while the firmware update runs.
drive_bridge_disconnected: Bluetooth bridge disconnected: manual driving waits until the bridge reaches the mower again.
bridge_empty: An ESPHome Bluetooth proxy next to the mower carries manual driving with low latency; everything else keeps going through the cloud.
bridge_outdated_esphome_version: The ESPHome release on the bridge is older than MowDeck expects. Rebuild and flash it.
bridge_outdated_project_version: The bridge runs an older MowDeck template. Rebuild it from the current template.
bridge_outdated_no_project: The firmware carries no esphome.project. Rebuild it from the current template.
bridge_status_pending: The gateway is opening the bridge; its state shows here as soon as it reaches it.
bridge_remove_body: The mower stays connected through the cloud; manual driving is then no longer possible.
bridge_host_help: IP address or host name of the bridge on the local network.
bridge_port_help: Port of the ESPHome API, normally 6053.
bridge_key_help: The value of api.encryption.key from the ESPHome secrets (secrets.yaml).
bridge_pick_hint: The bridge saw these mowers; the expected one is preselected.
bridge_blades_hint: Allows switching the blades on while driving with the joystick; the drive page has its own switch for it.
bridge_saved_body: The gateway is opening the bridge now. Connected, signal and firmware show under Bluetooth bridge once it is up.
bridge_error_unreachable: Proxy at {host}:{port} not reachable. Same network, bridge powered?
bridge_error_auth_failed: Key refused. Use the value of api.encryption.key.
bridge_error_timeout: No mower found. Is the bridge mounted on the switched-on mower?
bridge_error_busy: The bridge is in use right now, please wait a moment
bridge_error_already_connected: The mower is already connected through this bridge (by the mower entry “{name}”).
bridge_error_already_connected_unnamed: The mower is already connected through this bridge (by another mower entry).
bridge_error_unsupported: This connection cannot use a Bluetooth bridge.
bridge_error_not_found: No gateway holds this mower right now; wait a moment and try again.
bridge_error_gateway: No gateway answered; please try again later.
firmware_unsupported: Updates cannot be checked or installed over this connection; the version comes from the mower itself.
firmware_check_none: The firmware is up to date
firmware_check_error_unavailable: The mower or the manufacturer service does not answer right now.
firmware_block_not_docked: The mower must stand in the charging station.
firmware_block_job: No mowing job may be running or paused.
firmware_block_no_permission: You lack the right to control the mower.
firmware_confirm_body: The mower installs version {version}. It stays docked meanwhile; for about 10 to 20 minutes it cannot be used and restarts.
firmware_confirm_requirements: Requirements: docked, battery at least 70 %, no mowing job.
heat_gap_remow_hint: Opens spot mowing with this gap as the spot.
spot_open_hint: MowDeck drives the mower itself over a small patch: a circle or a shape on the map, spiral or stripes, blades off until you allow them.
spot_chip_tap: Tap the map to place the spot
spot_chip_placed: Spot placed · tap to move it
spot_outside: The spot must lie entirely inside one area.
spot_more_corners: Tap more corners on the map (at least three).
spot_spacing_hint: Cutting width {width} mm minus 50 mm overlap; narrower mows denser.
spot_speed_cap: At most {max} m/s: MowDeck steers the mower step by step over the drive link.
spot_blades_dry: Off: a dry run, the mower drives the route without cutting.
spot_blades_unsupported: This mower allows no blades while driving: dry run only.
spot_blades_confirm: I have checked that nobody is near the spot, and I stay within reach of the stop button.
link_signal_unknown: Bluetooth signal sufficient: not known yet
link_signal_unknown_hint: The bridge has not reported a signal strength yet; you can still start.
link_signal_weak_hint: Too weak for the drive link: move the bridge closer to the mower.
link_lost_bridge: Bluetooth bridge unreachable or signal too weak
spot_cond_rtk: RTK fix with an RTK position
spot_cond_idle: Mower ready (on the lawn, or docked and able to leave)
spot_cond_free: No job, no drive session, no spot run
spot_cond_fresh_hint: After the start the run waits for live positions (at most 2.5 s old, for up to 30 s) before the mower moves.
spot_preview_hint: The route appears on the map once the spot lies inside an area.
spot_run_waiting_rtk: Waiting for RTK fix after undocking
spot_stop_hint: Halts the mower at once and switches the blades off; the spot run ends.
spot_reason_geofence: the mower left the allowed area
spot_reason_sensor_stop: sensor stop of the mower (lift, tilt, collision)
spot_reason_heading_mismatch: heading does not match the compass
spot_reason_undock_failed: the mower did not leave its dock
spot_reason_no_route: no route to the spot on the map
spot_turn_hint_in_place: Rotates on the spot: fast, but an all-wheel-drive mower can scuff the turf.
spot_turn_hint_arc: Turns forward in a curve and spares the lawn.
spot_turn_hint_multi_point: A three-point turn with a short reverse leg, the blades off while reversing.
spot_turn_fallback: This drive link cannot reverse: multi-point turns are driven as arcs.
spot_launching: Waiting for live positions, then the mower moves.
spot_reason_stalled: no progress along the plan for 60 s
drive_speed_hint: The mower scales the stick by this setting, for the joystick and for spot runs. It is sent when you let go of the slider.
drive_speed_busy: Not while a spot run or a calibration is active.
calib_intro: MowDeck drives a few steps of about 6 s each straight ahead and on the spot and measures what the stick values mean on the ground. Spot runs then steer with these values.
calib_cond_idle: Mower idle on the lawn, out of the dock
calib_cond_rtk: RTK fix with an RTK position
calib_cond_free: No spot run or calibration active
calib_cond_room: About 2 m of free lawn straight ahead of the mower
calib_cond_room_hint: The browser cannot see this: look at the mower, then confirm.
calib_cond_blades: The blades stay off for the whole run
calib_not_allowed: Your role may not drive this mower.
calib_stop_hint: Halts the mower at once; the calibration ends without a result.
calib_outcome_outlier: dropped – slower than a smaller stick value
calib_outcome_hint: Only the steady part of each step counts, without its first 1.5 s. Steps with fewer than 4 reports in at least 3 s do not count; turns whose opposite turn differs clearly and values that fall as the stick grows are dropped.
calib_steps_empty: The first step is being driven.
calib_stored_none: No calibration stored yet; spot runs use the default values.
calib_speed_mismatch: The driving speed is {current} now, the calibration was measured at {stored}. Spot runs rescale the calibrated speed proportionally; recalibrating is recommended.
calib_reason_sensor_stop: sensor stop of the mower (lift, tilt, collision)
calib_reason_geofence: the mower left the allowed area
calib_reason_activity_change: the mower changed its activity (job, dock or error)
calib_reason_frame_rejected: the mower refused a drive command
calib_reason_no_fit: too few position reports for a fit
calib_reason_turn_direction: the mower turned the other way than commanded
camera_frozen_hint: The mower holds until the picture runs again. Then centre the stick or touch it again.
drive_recentre: Centre the stick or touch it again
